newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil edges up with futures, most prems hold.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil edges up with futures, most prems hold.

text.p: NWE gas oil was narrowly stronger on Wednesday although barge premiums did slip slightly. Cargo premiums were broadly steady.
March IPE gas oil was up $1.00 a tonne at $176.00, but activity was thin.
Barge premiums were off up to $1 putting second half February material at March IPE +50 cents on the bid side. Offers were heard up to +$2.50.
"Its a buyers market and no one is in a rush to get product," said one trader.
FOD was put steady around March IPE gas oil +$2-4 cif NWE for second half February, with very little interest shown for March material.
EN590 was holding onto premims of around March IPE +$18-19 cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean a Saras 25,000 tonne cargo traded at fob high quotes +$2.75 loading March 6-8.
